questions.question:
The given pie-chart shows the total number of children who opted different courses in a summer camp in May 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e89d45b24dad8823579d228bd30fecf9938cf51050b8cc722543f48ec60436d5.png] 

300 students attended the summer camp, and every child was allowed to opt only one activity for the camp. The total number of students who opted for Yoga and Painting taken together is how much less than the total number of children who opted for Music and Dance taken together?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The total number of students who opted for Yoga and Painting taken together = 300 × (18 + 12)%

⇒ 300 × 30%

⇒ 90

The total number of students who opted for Music and Dance taken together = 300 × (24 + 16)%

⇒ 300 × 40%

⇒ 120

Difference = 120 - 90

⇒ 30

**∴ The required answer is 30.**

Find the ratio of the number of successful start-ups in entertainment sector to the total number of start-ups in entertainment since 2016.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/276661e64e67d764ba7be040692203d77f54db32db5d7f8b0df818af9d3392d2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2cbc476b6bdbf587d8478c9d963e0ad4fd7b05c66bb1345ab8a4227a899ede9.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ From the above pie charts 

⇒ Number of successful start-ups in entertainment sector = 175

⇒ Total number of start-ups in entertainment since 2016 = 560

⇒ The ratio of the number of successful start-ups in the entertainment sector to the total number of start-ups in entertainment since 2016 = (175)/(560) = (5)/(16)

The given pie chart shows the percentage of students who enrolled in different hobby classes in a school. The number of students who enrolled in cooking classes is what percentage of those enrolled in dancing classes? (Rounded off to 2 digits after decimal)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43faf4ffb2b5d0c3e54b04a5c7e99836142521d8712f73814afbbee9cbb70e7e.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43faf4ffb2b5d0c3e54b04a5c7e99836142521d8712f73814afbbee9cbb70e7e.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of students be 100.

⇒ Number of students in cooking classes = 22% of 100 = (22)/(100) × 100 = 22

⇒ Number of students in dancing classes = 21% of 100 = (21)/(100) × 100 = 21

⇒ Percentage of students compared to each other = (22)/(21) × 100 = 104.76%

**Therefore, number of students who enrolled in cooking classes is 104.76% of those enrolled in dancing classes.**

Study the given pie charts carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a93c52060046312767b114b66714adb065c6187d4e6eca7134f817241c61a5b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a5d517f91090ce63f75c4e2b9e8f529837addc906843efd1de572aa556823fb.png] 

 

The expenditure on Food in 2021 was what percentage of the expenditure on Education in 2020?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Percentage of different types of expenditure in 2020 and 2021

**CONCEPT USED:**

100% represents Total expenditure in both cases respectively

**CALCULATION:**

Here, the Percentage of expenditure on Education in 2020 = 25%

⇒ Total expenditure in 2020 = Rs960000

Hence,

100% = 960000

25% = 240000

Now, the Percentage of expenditure on Food in 2021 = 20%

⇒Total expenditure in 2021 = Rs1080000

Hence,

100% = 1080000

20% = 216000

Now, we have to find the percentage of expenditure on food in 2021 to the expenditure on education in 2020

⇒ (216000/240000) × 100 = 90%

**Hence, the required percentage is 90%.**

questions.question:
The pie-chart given below shows the monthly expenditures made by a family under different heads as percentages of the total monthly income of the family. If the total monthly income of the family is ₹70,000, then what is the amount that is left with the family after only the food and medical expenditures for the month are made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0762f823fb7f763a92e41260de604191ce238814df60a3a9122fd46d0f153851.png]
questions.solution:
Given:

Total monthly income of a family = Rs 70,000

Percentage of expenditure for food = 28%

Percentage of expenditure for house rent = 14%

Percentage of expenditure for child education = 25%

Percentage of expenditure for medical = 10%

Percentage of expenditure for entertainment = 8%

Percentage of expenditure for provident fund = 15%

Concept Used:

Income left = Total Income – Income Spend

Calculation:

Amount spent on food = 28% of 70,000

Amount spent on food = (28)/(100) × 70000 = Rs 19,600

Amount spent on medical = 10% of 70,000

Amount spend on medical = (10)/(100) × 70000 = Rs 7,000

Total amount spent in food and medical = Rs 19,600 + Rs 7,000 = Rs 26,600

Amount left after spending on food and medical = Rs 70,000 – Rs 26,600 = Rs 43,400

∴ The amount left with the family after only the food and medical expenditures for the month is Rs 43,400

If the population below poverty line in village D is 42,000, then the total population in all the six villages taken together is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Population below poverty line in village D is 42,000.

**Calculation:**

Let the total population of the village is x.

Population of the village D is 20% of the total population.

60% of the population of the village D is below poverty line.

According to question

20% of x × 60% = 42,000

⇒ 1200x/10000 = 42,000

⇒ x = (42000 × 10000)/1200

⇒ x = 3,50,000

**∴ The total population in all the six villages taken together is 3,50,000.**
